versions.changelog:
Initial release: Create concise, conversion-oriented demo video scripts and motion storyboards for AI SaaS products.

- Transforms SaaS product workflows into 45-60 second demo video scripts focused on user input, AI output, review, and value.
- Provides generic script formula and timing template for consistent video structure.
- Includes detailed storyboard, motion, UI, and copywriting principles.
- Offers reference guides for Remotion, UI layering, data animation, and product fidelity.
- Designed for flexibility—supporting demo scripts, launch videos, walkthroughs, and motion storyboards.
